rationale: The 403/no-access empty state (OTable 'forbidden' prop -> o2-table-forbidden) is a brand-new generic surface with no existing coverage. A suite-wide grep for 'forbidden|no-access|noAccess|o2-table-forbidden|access denied' returned zero test assertions (only unrelated '403' HTTP-status strings in cleanup.spec.js and 'forbidden identifiers' comments in dashboard utils). No GeneralTests spec touches OTable's forbidden branch, so a new spec is required. Because the feature is a generic OTable/OEmptyState mechanism consumed by Dashboards and Alerts, it belongs in GeneralTests (matching run-context spec_path) and must be registered in ci_matrix.json under the GeneralTests shard run_files.
